convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load 'Candles_Smoothed' custom indicator and includes TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for trade execution logic. Custom indicator buffer 4 is used for trend detection, requiring the custom indicator to be replicated.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds for signal timestamping
min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation

other_exits: When both BuyPosOpen and BuyPosClose are enabled and trend remains 1 on previous signal bar, BUY_Close is set to true (line 138) - closes long if trend persists without fresh crossover
When both SellPosOpen and SellPosClose are enabled and trend remains 0 on previous signal bar, SELL_Close is set to true (line 137) - closes short if trend persists without fresh crossover

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM parameter: fraction of deposit allocated per trade (0.1 = 10% of free margin)

custom_logic_notes: Uses Candles_Smoothed custom indicator buffer 4 as a binary trend filter (0=bearish, 1=bullish). Entry on crossover of buffer 4 between 0 and 1. The EA also has a secondary close mechanism (lines 137-138): if both open and close flags are enabled for the same direction, and the trend value on the previous signal bar matches the position direction (no fresh crossover), it still triggers a close. SignalBar input (default=1) means signals are evaluated on a completed bar (bar index 1), not the current forming bar. The Recount flag acts as a retry mechanism if CopyBuffer fails. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose functions with money management and position gating logic internally.
python_conversion_notes: Must replicate Candles_Smoothed indicator logic (buffer 4 trend state) since it's a custom indicator with multiple smoothing methods (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA beyond standard MA). The TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions need to be reimplemented: position open/close with MM fraction-based sizing, deviation control, and the GlobalVariableDel_ cleanup. The binary trend detection (buffer 4 crossing between 0 and 1) is straightforward once the smoothed candle logic is ported. SL/TP of 1000/2000 are in points (not pips) - for 5-digit brokers these represent 100/200 pips respectively; no explicit digit adjustment in the EA code so the values are used as-is with the platform's point system.
